stem: Which sentence from the selection best shows that the Sainsbury's company tries to make use of a by-product?

options.label: A
options.text: Offering shoppers the freshest and most appealing products possible is a good start. (paragraph 3)

options.label: B
options.text: Special trucks collect food waste from more than 1,200 grocery stores all over England. (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: Some of the methane trapped during the process fuels the trucks. (paragraph 5)

options.label: D
options.text: So far Europe has mainly led the way in biofuel development. (paragraph 7)
